owner_posts.post_text:
Quick RO Service Near Juhu Beach – A Real Customer Experience

Last Sunday afternoon near Juhu Beach, one of our regular customers from a nearby apartment in Juhu called us with an urgent issue.

Their Aquaguard RO water purifier had stopped giving clean drinking water, and the taste had become unusual. With Mumbai’s water quality concerns, they were worried about their family’s health and needed safe, pure, and hygienic drinking water immediately.

They contacted with us at RO Doctor service expert on call Within a few hours, our technician reached their home.
After inspection, we found that the Aquaguard RO filters were completely choked, and the membrane needed replacement due to long usage.

We explained everything clearly, replaced the filters with genuine, eco-friendly compatible parts, and cleaned the system to restore natural, mineral-balanced, and safe drinking water.

The difference was noticeable instantly better taste, smooth flow, and most importantly, clean and healthy water for daily use.

The customer appreciated our honest service, quick response, and affordable pricing something we always focus on at RO Doctor.

At RO Doctor, we don’t just repair water purifier machines we ensure every home gets pure, safe, and naturally healthy drinking water without hassle.

Need a trusted RO service near Juhu, Andheri, Vile Parle & all Mumbai ? Call RO Doctor 

📞 Same-day service available

Reliable Performance for Over 2 Years – Neeo NF+UV (NF80 + UV)

I have been using the Neeo NF+UV (Model: NF80 + UV) water purifier for the last 2 years, and it has been performing exceptionally well. The water quality has remained consistently clean and safe.
Maintenance has been simple, and the service as well, I am doing by seeing their video whenever required.

featured_reviews.name: Vishwanath Dalvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I own a CM water purifier. The company presents itself as a brand focused on quality, transparency, and customer-first values. However, my experience after purchasing the product has been extremely disappointing.

The real test of any company begins after the sale, and CM has completely failed in that regard. I have been trying to get service support for my purifier and have contacted the Airoli service desk multiple times. I have called them and sent messages on three separate occasions. Each time, I was assured that a technician would visit the next day. Unfortunately, no technician ever arrived, and there was no follow-up communication.

This is one of the most frustrating customer service experiences I have encountered. The company markets itself by criticizing how other brands exploit customers, but once their own service is required, they seem to ignore customers completely. Making promises and repeatedly failing to honor them is unacceptable.

I would strongly advise potential buyers to consider the quality of after-sales support before purchasing from this company. A good product means little when the company refuses to respond when customers need help.

featured_reviews.name: MALHAR MATONDKAR
featured_reviews.review_text:
Biokraft Foods highly recommends CM Purifiers for their UF + UV 200 system. The product has proven to be reliable, efficient, and well-suited for food processing applications where consistent water quality is essential.
The UF + UV combination delivers dependable purification, and the robust 1/2 HP pump (Crompton/Kirloskar) with skid ensures stable pressure and smooth, uninterrupted operation. The overall build quality and performance reflect strong engineering and suitability for industrial use.
We also appreciate the end-to-end support provided, including timely installation, included services, and warranty coverage, which adds significant value to the offering.
Based on our experience, CM Purifiers is a trustworthy partner for high-quality water purification solutions, and we would confidently recommend their systems to other businesses.

featured_reviews.name: Vishwanath Nayak
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently purchased a water purifier from CM Purifiers, and I couldn’t be happier with the decision. What truly set this experience apart was the personal attention from the owner, Mr. Chandan Mantri.

He took the time to explain the specific filtration stages required for a municipal water supply and helped me navigate the maintenance requirements. Rather than pushing the most expensive model, Mr. Mantri focused on what would genuinely work best for my family’s needs. This level of personalized guidance gave me total confidence in my purchase.

The installation was seamless, the build quality is top-notch, and the water tastes amazing. If you’re looking for a brand that actually cares about its customers, this is it. I bought Neoo UF + UV booster with 10ltrs of storage capacity with Steel tank. I highly recommend supporting this business
